integrity: Proof is direct for all dimensions. Computational checks are finite corroboration. Same-model review only; no independent audit or validation claimed.
limitations: Only feasibility of parameter pairs on binary hypercubes, not classification of every perfect coloring or nonbinary Hamming graphs. Historical priority against all equitable-partition/coding results remains provisional.
scientific_claim: The complete existence region for FAT colorings of binary hypercubes: for d>=1 and k>=2, exactly k=2^r, alpha=t/d, r,t>=1, (k-1)t<=d; exact FAT chromatic number and proper-coloring boundary.
title: Complete FAT-coloring spectrum of binary hypercubes
